description: The plot in Figure 4 illustrates the mean absolute values before and after gating, with the x-axis labeled "Layer" and having a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5, and no units are specified. The dashed blue line shows a steady increase across the x-axis, while the dotted orange and solid green lines remain relatively stable and close to 0.
